additional_info.subject: ID0391524-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / NN 170000044] LED color issue CRM:00643001104
additional_info.body:
Dear Simen,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0391524 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-NO SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Maybe
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Spare Part Ordering
Maybe
Performance monitoring by RC
Please arrange for a site intervention to inspect the LED wiring and their respective connections. Additionally, kindly ensure a spare component is available during the intervention in case any part is damaged and needs replacement.
Please verify that the connection to the KF15 is receiving a continuous 24VDC supply. Also, check the wiring connections at the XD23, XD24, and XD8 terminals. Ensure to carry a spare KF15 with the following MLFB: 8EM5903-0AA01-5AA8.
Lastly, kindly check the feasibility of the FC17 fuse component as well.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-NO SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [11/07/2023], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
